surfaces.coverage: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 63.91 km effective diameter (catalog ±1 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size supplies a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative. ATLAS2015–2018 photometry gives 310 orange and 144 cyan measurements; period search with convex models. Both mirror poles remain; model 4799 is selected as a representative, not a unique orientation. The thermal scale is approximate. Convex inversion supplies broad outline without resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point in 3D; source barycentric radius and normal. No radial branch selection.
